description: This file defines the interface IntegrationTestApplicationClientFactory, which extends ApplicationClientFactory. It provides factory methods to create instances of ApplicationClientFactory implementations, as well as methods to create message senders and legacy command clients for testing purposes in the Hono project.

classes.name: IntegrationTestApplicationClientFactory
classes.description: An interface extending ApplicationClientFactory, providing factory methods for integration testing with Hono, including creation of message senders and legacy command clients.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static method to create a new factory instance using a given HonoConnection.

methods.name: createGenericMessageSender
methods.description: Creates a new MessageSender for a specified target address.

methods.name: createLegacyCommandClient
methods.description: Creates a legacy command client scoped to a tenant and device, used for command & control API testing.
